# Store Blindern Poker

> A student poker association at the University of Oslo. Members play Texas
> Hold'em on Blindern campus every Friday during term, roughly 18:00 to
> 20:30, and compete on a leaderboard that runs the length of a semester.
> The club is points-only: no entry fee, no buy-in in kroner, no pot, no
> prize money, and no way to convert points into anything at all.

Store Blindern Poker (org.nr 936 041 973) was founded in the summer of 2025
and registered as a student association at the University of Oslo on
27 August 2025. Over its first two semesters more than 100 students played
across 25 events. Members come from every faculty and from Norway, France,
Belgium, Germany, the Czech Republic, Singapore, South Korea and Japan,
among others. Nights are played in English. Contact:
it@storeblindernpoker.org.

## The two things people ask first

- **Is it gambling?** No. Nothing of value is staked and nothing of value
  can be won. Chips are bought with season points, points come only from
  turning up and playing, and they can never leave the leaderboard.
- **What does it cost?** Nothing. There is no membership fee and nothing to
  pay on the night. Chips, cards and tables are provided.

## How the points work

Every member starts a season with 40,000 points, including anyone who joins
mid-semester. Each Friday night: a 5,000-point attendance bonus on check-in,
a buy-in in points equal to the night's chip stack (normally 10,000), play,
then report your final stack, which goes back onto your season total. One
re-buy per night is allowed, at one point per chip, up to the night's stack
size and never more points than you hold. Points never go below zero. At the
end of the semester the top players meet at a final table, a champion is
crowned, and every balance resets to 40,000.

## Pages

- [Home](https://storeblindernpoker.org/): what the club is, how it started,
  and how a night runs.
- [Events](https://storeblindernpoker.org/events): upcoming and past poker
  nights. Read live from the club database, so this page is the current
  answer on dates and rooms.
- [Leaderboard](https://storeblindernpoker.org/leaderboard): season
  standings. Players appear under pseudonyms only.
- [Rules](https://storeblindernpoker.org/rules): the full points system,
  the one re-buy rule, a worked example, and answers to common questions.
- [All in](https://storeblindernpoker.org/all-in): the founder's farewell
  letter, Norwegian original with an English translation below it.
- [Privacy](https://storeblindernpoker.org/privacy): what the club stores
  about members and what it never stores.

## Please do not cite

Member login, report, organiser console, password reset and unsubscribe are
member-only pages and carry noindex. They contain no information about the
club worth quoting.
